resources.string: Choose a connection method
Wireless and USB have separate checks and guides. Choose how to connect.
3 steps: enable the native hotspot → check credentials → connect iPhone.
3 steps: use a USB data port → allow USB access → allow CarPlay on iPhone.
Back to connection methods
Reconnect current connection
Restart the current wireless or USB connection when controls, audio or video stop responding.
No session is available to reconnect. Choose a connection method first.
Uses the current connection method. Progress follows the actual session status.
Wireless connection · 3 steps
1 · Enable the Android native hotspot
2 · Check the hotspot name and password
3 · Join the hotspot on iPhone and connect
The saved name and password must match the Android native hotspot. Saving credentials does not enable it.
Details saved. Check that they match the system hotspot.
Action needed: read or enter complete hotspot details.
Join the hotspot in iPhone Wi-Fi settings and keep Wi-Fi and Bluetooth on. Select the paired iPhone, tap Wireless connection, and allow CarPlay when prompted.
Select an iPhone. Selecting a phone does not establish a connection.
Phone selected. Connection is confirmed only by the CarPlay session.
Native hotspot state
Checking
Detected as on
Off
Unable to confirm
This is the last check result. If unknown, verify it in native settings.
Hotspot activation not confirmed
Hotspot is on
Stopped waiting
Hotspot is on; new details were not applied
Details saved; activation not confirmed
The system accepted the new details and the app saved them, but hotspot activation is not confirmed. Enable it in native settings; no need to generate new details.
Read complete; details saved
Could not read hotspot details
Waiting for the system result. Nothing is confirmed yet. Do not tap again; you can stop waiting.
USB connection · 3 steps
1 · Connect to a USB data port
2 · Allow USB access
3 · Allow CarPlay on iPhone
Check USB again
Checking USB support, devices and permissions…
Unsupported: the system does not declare USB Host capability. This connection method is unavailable.
Action needed: no Apple USB device detected. Use a data cable and a vehicle data port, unlock iPhone, then reconnect.
Detected %1$d Apple USB device(s). USB permission and the CarPlay handshake are still required.
Permission needed: tap Connect and allow the Android USB prompt. Reconnection may request permission again.
USB access granted for the detected devices. This alone does not confirm a CarPlay connection.
Keep iPhone unlocked and allow CarPlay when prompted. This guide does not check hotspot or Bluetooth settings. If no picture appears, try another data cable and data port.
Check failed: USB status could not be read. Retry or collect a report in Debug & logs.
USB is not ready
Wait for a USB connection
Reads device and permission status only. It does not request permission or send USB commands. Check again after reconnecting.
Before connecting · Bluetooth and iPhone pairing
Enable Bluetooth on the head unit and iPhone, then select the paired iPhone here. Wireless CarPlay uses Bluetooth for setup and Wi-Fi for transport; Bluetooth music playback is not required.
Prerequisites passed: Bluetooth is on and the selected phone is paired. The CarPlay session determines actual connection status.
Unsupported: no Bluetooth adapter is available for wireless CarPlay. Go back to choose USB.
Action needed: head unit Bluetooth is off. Enable Bluetooth on both devices and pair iPhone, then return to connect.
Permission needed: paired devices cannot be read. Tap Select iPhone and allow Bluetooth access, then check pairing.
Pairing no longer valid: the saved phone is not in the paired device list. Pair and select iPhone again.
Check failed: Bluetooth and pairing status could not be confirmed. Check system Bluetooth settings and retry.
Bluetooth settings could not be opened. Open them from the head unit system settings, enable Bluetooth and pair iPhone.
On your iPhone
Pending: USB access can be checked after an Apple USB device is detected.

With ADB connected to the head unit from a computer, try:
adb shell appops set com.ecarx.carplay ACTIVATE_VPN allow

Check the result:
adb shell appops get com.ecarx.carplay ACTIVATE_VPN

Return to the app and tap “Check and request consent again”. An allowed operation does not confirm a successful wired connection.
